headline.title: Hoax bomb emails hit schools in Northern Ireland and Scotland
headline.quip: The threats were fake. The evacuations, closures and lost school day were real.
headline.summary: Schools in Northern Ireland and Scotland received hoax bomb emails. Northern Ireland minister Paul Givan said 160 schools received a threat, while other reports put the number at up to 300; some schools closed or evacuated. Police Scotland treated the messages as a hoax.
